sourceNote: 2024 practice summary, not a statement of current law: 10tv Verify, 'These states can count votes before Election Day 2024' (summarizing NCSL and Brennan Center research), and NPR, 'When will mail-in and absentee ballots be counted?' (2024-11-04). The source distinguishes states that may begin processing and counting before Election Day from states that may process, but not count, ballots before polls close. Omitted jurisdictions are unknown here; callers must not infer a zero or an early-mail-first rule.
